name: Church of Our Lady Queen of Peace
notes: Sacred Heart Devotion is also held after the evening Mass on the first Friday of the month.
Divine Mercy Chaplet is recited after the 6.30pm Mass on the last Friday of the month.

devotions: Sacred Heart Devotion: 1st Friday of the month at 12.00 noon & after evening Mass.
Divine Mercy Chaplet: recited after 6.30pm Mass every last Fri of the month.
Daily recitation of the Rosary after all evening Masses: 7pm on Weekdays and 6pm on Weekends at Assumption Garden.
